items: Blackstone: up to 9.99% in **Federal Bank** (₹6,196.51 crore); ICICI group: 9.95% each in HDFC Bank, IDFC FIRST Bank, Equitas SFB, Federal Bank; **Bain Capital: 41.66% joint-control in Manappuram Finance (₹4,385 crore)**; SBI Mutual Fund: up to 9.99% in Bandhan Bank and RBL Bank.
** 🔄 Update:** RBI formally **clears** Bain Capital's investment in Manappuram's subsidiaries — Asirvad Micro Finance and Manappuram Home Finance — confirming the ₹4,385 crore deal announced in Feb.

blocks.content: 🎯 Exam Angle → No marker for the acquirer-target-stake matching, except Bain-Manappuram (41.66% / ₹4,385 crore) which is now a completed, cleared deal — highest-recall item in this cluster.
